tooltip.radiologistics.wired_inertia_fuz:
Acts as an impact-detonated fuze.
- Can be inserted into big cannon shells.
- When the shell block is powered by redstone, it will launch the projectile in the facing direction without exploding on the spot.
tooltip.radiologistics.main_computer:
Central processing unit of your network.
§6Nodes: §rAll basic math, logic, text, and variables.
- Right-click to open node programming GUI.
tooltip.radiologistics.radio_transmitter:
Broadcasts wireless messages on redstone power.
- Right-click to edit Channel and Message.
- Target with §eAntenna§7 to link and boost range.
tooltip.radiologistics.redstone_link_mod:
Interfaces external redstone links with the network.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Link Input: §7Reads signals from wireless redstone channels.
§e- Link Output: §7Sends wireless signals to redstone channels.
tooltip.radiologistics.memory_module:
Saves and retrieves network variables persistently.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Variable: §7Reads stored values from memory database.
§e- Set Variable: §7Writes new values to memory database.
tooltip.radiologistics.gyroscope_sensor:
Measures orientation and position.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Gyroscope: §7Reads Pitch and Yaw angles.
§e- Gyroscope Position: §7Reads absolute coordinate positions.
tooltip.radiologistics.antenna:
Increases transmitter and receiver range.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Antenna Input: §7Receives signals on radio channels.
§e- Antenna Output: §7Broadcasts signals to radio channels.
- Target transmitter/computer first, then place base.
- Stack vertically (+150 blocks range per segment).
tooltip.radiologistics.jammer:
Disrupts radio communications in specified ranges.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Jammer: §7Jams a configurable range of channels when active.
tooltip.radiologistics.audio_module:
Plays audio and text-to-speech wirelessly.
§6Added Nodes:
§e- Sound Play: §7Streams audio from URLs (WAV/MP3/YouTube).
§e- Text Speak: §7Announces text using local Text-to-Speech.
The Radio Transmitter broadcasts wireless signals when powered by redstone.
Right-click it to configure the channel (0-255) and transmission message.
First, right-click the transmitter with the antenna in hand to target it.
Then place the antenna. It will connect to the targeted transmitter.
Stacking multiple antenna segments vertically sums their height to boost transmission range.
radiologistics.ponder.network_scene.head: Computer Network Setup
radiologistics.ponder.network_scene.text: First, place the Main Computer. It is the CPU of your network.
Right-click the computer with the module in hand to set it as a target.
Then place the module block. It will connect to the targeted computer.
You can also connect a Display Link and a Network Controller from Create Radars
